races.verdict: COASTING is given a chance to build on his promising 7f course second earlier in the month. Willie McCreery's Bella Colombia caught the eye at Leopardstown recently and this former C&D scorer is second choice. Moyassr 's good C&D record brings him into the reckoning, while the selection's stablemate Gavoo is well treated if a return to all-weather sparks a revival. COASTING (IRE) BELLA COLOMBIA (IRE) MOYASSR (IRE)

races.display_title: Irishinjuredjockeys.com Fillies Maiden
races.verdict: SONIC SABIHA has a fair bit to find with the standard-setter Nevermindtherain , but she looked unlucky not to win over C&D on her most recent outing and gives the impression there's an even bigger performance in her. Aidan O'Brien newcomer Slightly makes plenty of appeal on paper, while Golden Alibi showed promise in the face of a stiff task at Fairyhouse last month and is open to improvement. SONIC SABIHA (IRE) NEVERMINDTHERAIN (IRE) SLIGHTLY (IRE)

races.verdict: Three-time C&D winner UNA MATATA is very well treated on her form here earlier in the year and having produced her best effort for some time when third over C&D 12 days ago, she could well be ready to strike. Leannespour remains pretty lightly raced and isn't one to be writing off from her basement mark, whilst Expound finds himself operating from a career-low mark if bouncing back over this shorter trip. Roman Harry completes the shortlist. UNA MATATA (IRE) LEANNESPOUR (IRE) EXPOUND

races.verdict: CRAYONS IN THE SKY represents some strong form lines and posted her best effort yet when runner up over C&D on her penultimate start. races.display_title: Host Your Conference At Huntingdon Racecourse Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: SERAPHIC was suited by the emphasis on speed when recording a first hurdles win on these shores at Stratford recently, but he still did well to come from last and looks capable of defying a 6 lb higher mark providing this doesn't come too soon just 11 days on. Gallivanted should strip fitter for his recent run and make more of an impact in this weaker affair, while Zafaan shouldn't be judged too harshly on his latest effort on the level and remains of interest back over hurdles. SERAPHIC (IRE) GALLIVANTED (FR) ZAFAAN (IRE)

races.verdict: KNIGHTON showed up well for a long way on his return from 5 months off at Market Rasen recently and is put forward as the answer from the same mark, given he's entitled to strip fitter for the outing and remains relatively unexposed. races.verdict: STAR ROSE made a promising start when beaten just 4 lengths by the Futurity runner-up Gran Dia on debut at Salisbury 4 weeks ago. That wasn't unexpected given her strength in the betting that day and she can take this with improvement forthcoming. Flash of Colour , High Society (a stable companion of the selection) and Lady Bb are appealing newcomers. STAR ROSE (GER) FLASH OF COLOUR HIGH SOCIETY

races.verdict: A competitive finale with the narrow vote in favour of STRONG VOICE . James Horton's 3-y-o has found only one too good on 2 of his last 3 starts and wasn't seen to very best effect when fourth over C&D 3 weeks ago. He's fancied to go well from a handy draw, with hat-trick seeking Whitesnake , Split Elevens and Herculeus others to consider. STRONG VOICE (IRE) WHITESNAKE SPLIT ELEVENS
